manifest.title: The chamber's imprint at every frequency

finding: The chamber does not ring: no case shows a peak standing 20% above its surroundings between 6 and 240 Hz. Under a surface wave the imprint's largest value is 0.163 of the motion over the axis, at 79 Hz (Q 0.9); 1.980 for the favourable room (Q 0.9). Waves from below: at most 0.306 (P, Q 1.4) and 0.344 (S, Q 3.5). At the low end the imprint approaches P2-04's static answer (0.96 to 1.82 of it between 6 and 12 Hz). Halving the grid changes the imprint by at most 6% below 120 Hz (11% for the favourable room).
